events.label: birth
events.text: Born in Silstedt near Wernigerode, Province of Saxony.

evidence.quote: Hartmann was born on 11 December 1902 in Silstedt near Wernigerode
( 11 December 1902 – 26 April 1963 )

events.text: Began attending Volksschule in Silstedt.

evidence.quote: From 1909 to 1914 , he attended the Volksschule

events.text: Ended Volksschule; later attended Gymnasium in Magdeburg district.

evidence.quote: From 1909 to 1914 , he attended the Volksschule

events.text: Joined Royal Prussian Cadet Corps in Oranienstein.

evidence.quote: On 1 April 1914 , Hartmann joined the Königlich Preußischen Kadettenkorps

events.text: Transferred to Main Military Academy in Berlin-Lichterfelde.

evidence.quote: he transferred to the Hauptkadettenanstalt ( Main Military Academy ) in Berlin-Lichterfelde on 1 April 1917

events.text: Graduated with Abitur at the Berlin-Lichterfelde academy.

evidence.quote: There he graduated with his Abitur ( diploma ) in 1921

events.text: Began naval career with the Reichsmarine as member of Crew 21.

evidence.quote: began his naval career with the Reichsmarine of the Weimar Republic on 1 April 1921

events.text: Began basic military training in Stralsund.

evidence.quote: It began with basic military training ( 1 April – 30 September 1921 )

events.text: Began onboard training after transfer (unit name missing).

evidence.quote: Hartmann was then transferred to the ( 1 October 1921 – April 1922 ) for onboard training

events.text: Moved to training ship Niobe for training.

evidence.quote: then to the training ship Niobe ( April – 30 June 1922 )

events.text: Advanced in rank to Fähnrich zur See.

evidence.quote: he advanced in rank to Fähnrich zur See ( officer cadet ) on 1 April 1923

events.text: Advanced in rank to Oberfähnrich zur See.

evidence.quote: Oberfähnrich zur See ( Senior Ensign ) on 4 April 1925

events.text: Transferred to the U-boat arm.

evidence.quote: before transferring to the U-boat arm in 1935
